# AI Coding Instructions for SyncClipboard / NexClip

## 🎨 UI & Icon Standards (STRICT)
- **NO EMOJIS**: Strictly forbid using emoji characters (e.g. 🗓️, 💻, 📱, ✕, ❌, ⭐, 🔥) anywhere in UI labels, chips, buttons, dialogs, or empty state text.
- **USE LUCIDE VECTOR ICONS**:
  - In Android: use clip.yixing.sync.ui.LucideIcons or 	op.yukonga.miuix.kmp.icon.MiuixIcons.
  - In Windows Desktop: use NexClip.Desktop.Services.Lucide SVG icons.

## 🛠️ Build & Runtime Rules
- OS: Windows (PowerShell).
- Windows desktop: DO NOT auto-launch NexClip.exe after building; user starts it manually.
- Communication: Always answer in Chinese.
